Alex: Heads up — starting onboarding smoke for icarus-6b v1. Weights uploaded to s3://redwood-models/icarus-6b/v1/weights.pt. Can people sanity-check tokenizer + serving config? planning perf runs after smoke.

Maria: Quick note: tokenizer in this repo sometimes inserts a leading space for emoji tokens which shifts tokenization offsets (seen with "🔥" and :thumbsup:). Minimal repro below.

Maria: ```python
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
t = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('redwood/icarus-6b-tokenizer')
print(t.encode('Hello🔥'))  # -> [154, 999, ...]  # extra space token before emoji
```

Sam: Config validator flagged missing `pad_token_id` in serving YAML (model.config.pad_token_id is None). Suggest adding `pad_token_id: 0` to serving.yaml. Also saw quantize: q4_0 in the catalog entry — confirm that's intended for initial bench.

Jin: Running a quick bench sweep now. Command: `./bench/run_bench --model s3://redwood-models/icarus-6b/v1/weights.pt --batch 8 --seq 512 --quant q4_0` — will post numbers when done.

BenchBot: Automated bench started (run id 2241000000-1) — ETA ~6m.

Jin: First pass (batch=8, seq=512, kv_cache=true): p50=31ms, p95=95ms, p99=210ms. Throughput ~360 tok/s per GPU. Looks like p99 spiky on long sequences.

Alex: Those p99s are high for the catalog target. Is cache warming or are we seeing tail due to batching? Can you try continuous_batching + batch_size=16?

Jin: Tried continuous_batching=true + batch_size=16 + seq=256: p50=28ms, p95=70ms, p99=120ms; throughput ~520 tok/s/gpu. Improvement is consistent when kv_cache warmed. Log snippet:

Jin: ```
[2026-03-17T14:02:12Z] request_id=run-2241 batch=16 seq=256 p50=28ms p95=70ms p99=120ms throughput=520 tok/s/gpu
[2026-03-17T14:02:18Z] kv_cache_hit_rate=0.88 prefix_cache_hits=2400
```

Sasha: @Alex @Jin I opened a tiny PR to set pad_token_id and document the emoji tokenizer quirk — please review: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/492. I also added a short note in tokenizer/README.md.

OpsBot: Reminder: Dedicated smoke window 14:00-15:00 UTC today. Deploys blocked outside that window. :calendar:

Alex: OK plan: Sasha's PR -> merge, add pad_token_id: 0 to serving.yaml, then run final perf (continuous_batching=true, batch_size=16, quant=q4_0). If final p99 < 150ms we're good to promote to staging. Thanks all :thumbsup:
